assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: bold flat editorial illustration for a professional AI research presentation, artwork only. Art direction: contemporary two-color screenprint / linocut magazine illustration. Crisp decisive BLACK INK linework, solid DEEP INDIGO shapes, warm cream negative space, a few restrained amber marks, sparse imperfect halftone and hand-printed ink grain. Flat 2D graphic composition, no simulated materials or rendering. Subject: persistent memory represented by an open, organized archive of interconnected record pages. A single confident ink route threads through earlier records and reaches one clearly highlighted indigo current record, while the older pages remain visible. Deliberate, intelligent visual metaphor, striking silhouette and strong composition. Make it feel commissioned for a serious science magazine, not generic corporate clip art. Landscape 16:9, illustration on the right 58 percent, the left 42 percent almost entirely blank cream so editable PowerPoint text can be added. Keep shapes large, details sparse, lots of breathing room. Palette cream #F5F1E8, near-black #202127, deep indigo #5844C6, muted amber #BE844E. NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO logo, NO UI cards, NO charts, NO human head or brain. ABSOLUTELY NO 3D, no glass, no acrylic, no metal, no realistic shadows, no photorealism, no gradients, no glowing neural network, no holograms, no floating cubes. Do not make a finished slide or add a title.
